$comment: Single source of truth for which environment INSTANCES exist. Keyed by instance name (dev1, uat2, staging, ...) -- 'tier' points into .github/tiers.json for sizing, so many instances can share one tier. region_index must be globally unique across this ENTIRE file (it drives non-overlapping CIDR allocation in modules/*/region-stack) -- scripts/generate-environment.cjs picks the next free one automatically; never reuse one by hand. Consumed by the generate-matrix job in every terraform-*.yml workflow, by scripts/new-region.*, and by scripts/generate-environment.cjs.
